topic: 裂脑综合征与意识统一性之争

sources.title: Split-Brain: What We Know Now and Why This is Important for Understanding Consciousness
sources.authors: de Haan EHF, Corballis PM, Hillyard SA, Marzi CA, Seth A, Lamme VAF, Volz L, Gazzaniga M
sources.access_method: PMC open access full text read
sources.key_content: Split-brain综合综述：感知分裂证据、行动统一证据、皮层下整合机制、意识理论预测、未解问题。核心结论：证据尚不足以回答意识是否分裂。

sources.title: The Split-Brain Phenomenon Revisited: A Single Conscious Agent with Split Perception
sources.authors: Pinto Y, de Haan EHF, Lamme VAF
sources.access_method: abstract only — no PMC open access
sources.key_content: 单一意识代理人+分裂感知可报告性框架。任意手响应范式：允许任一手响应时，患者可检测全视野刺激，支持行动统一性。
sources.limitations: 未读取全文；核心实验细节和数据通过de Haan 2020综述中的引用补充理解

sources.title: Unified Tactile Detection and Localisation in Split-Brain Patients
sources.authors: de Haan EHF, Fabri M, Dijkerman HC, Foschi N, Lattanzi S, Pinto Y
sources.access_method: abstract only — no PMC open access confirmed
sources.key_content: 裂脑患者可用任意一手指示全身任意位置的触觉刺激存在和定位，但双手位置配对失败。触觉检测和定位的跨半球统一性。

sources.title: Alien hand syndrome: Pathophysiology, semiology and differential diagnosis with psychiatric disorders (Review)
sources.authors: Manea MC, Iliuta FP, Manea M, Lacau RM, Varlam CI, Mares AM, Ciobanu CA, Ciobanu AM

sources.title: Some Effects of Disconnecting the Cerebral Hemispheres — Nobel Lecture
sources.key_content: Sperry's original framework: each separated hemisphere is an independent conscious mental entity; right hemisphere has its own genuine perceptions, will, and thoughts; two conscious agents in split-brain patients
